name: Genuine Edge Probe — Producer Leaf
description: Minimal deterministic producer leaf for the first genuine capability->capability composition (drives the honest lambda_1 / genuine_edges signal above 0). Runs one deterministic bash step and emits its result under the chainable shape 'genuine_chain_signal' so a downstream consumer activity can consume it via shape-flow. Pairs with genuine-edge-probe-consumer (consumes genuine_chain_signal) and genuine-edge-probe-orchestrator (composes both). Idiomatic: reuses the native 'bash' resolver and the engine's outputShapes stamping (ensureImpulse) — no LLM, no network, no executor change.

tasks.description: Deterministically emit a chain signal payload. The engine stamps this task's declared outputShape ('genuine_chain_signal') onto the bash resolver's commandResult impulse via ensureImpulse, so the impulse lands in the pool under the chainable shape.

metadata.author: genuine-edge-bootstrap
